thread:
alert-manager: Alert: SYNTHETIC_CHECK flapping us-east-2 / text-gen-canary — 6 failures in 10m (sensitivity=med-high). Triggered at 1745678901
sam (oncall): paging — got the alert, i'll take first look. any customer reports? :eyes:
tia (support): seeing two support reports from customers "ecorp" and "brightapps" complaining about intermittent 504s around 12:07-12:12. opened ticket #8122 and #8123.
leah (sre): metrics quick check: regional 5xx rate has a tiny uptick aligned with probes but overall <0.2% of traffic. pattern looks like probe amplification rather than bulk failure. i do see a rolling job that touched cache params at ~11:55.
omar (eng-runtime): confirmed — a rollout adjusted LRU settings briefly, about 20% of nodes restarted with new runtime flags. KV miss spike matches probe timestamps.
sam (oncall): i'd prefer we avoid a page storm. can we move this alert to a non-pager while we triage? not full suppression, just reduce noise.
leah (sre): suggested mitigation: 1) increase probe interval (30s -> 120s) 2) change failure window to 12m and threshold to 3 (3/12) 3) enable exponential backoff for the probe after 2 failures (30s -> 60s -> 120s -> 300s) 4) add a suppression rule: if prod 5xx rate <0.25% do not page. downside: detection latency increases.
omar (eng-runtime): config draft to apply (staging first): ```yaml
probes:
  us-east-2:
    interval_s: 120
    failure_window_m: 12
    failure_threshold: 3
    backoff_on_failures: true
    backoff_steps_s: [60,120,300]
    suppression_thresholds:
      global_5xx_pct: 0.25
```
sam (oncall): good. i'll /snooze the pager while we push config to staging. command: `/snooze-alert synthetic-check-us-east-2 60m --reason "triage & avoid pager churn"`
alert-manager: Action accepted — synthetic-check-us-east-2 snoozed for 60 minutes by sam (oncall).
tia (support): copied support tickets into the incident: https://redwood.support/tickets/8122 and /8123. i put customers on watch and asked for logs & repro times.
leah (sre): i'll add a transient dashboard panel called "Synth Stability (us-east-2)" and an annotation for this incident. PromQLs i'll add: `sum(rate(synth_probe_failures_total{region="us-east-2"}[5m])) by (probe)` and `increase(synth_probe_debounce_skips_total[1h])`. also will annotate deploy at 11:55.
omar (eng-runtime): deploying patch to staging now (1745678960). will run probe simulator against staged runtime and watch for flapping after backoff logic.
sam (oncall): leaving a handoff note for next oncall: if overall product 5xx >0.5% or customer tickets escalate, remove snooze and page SRE leads. otherwise keep watch until snooze expires.
leah (sre): followups: 1) monitoring PR with new alert semantics 2) runbook addendum describing backoff tradeoffs 3) RFC for global probe defaults (will assign). i'll create monitoring PR and link it here.
tia (support): support ticket #8122 updated with incident link INC-2024-2099 and preliminary mitigation notes. asking customers for traces.
omar (eng-runtime): staging looks stable with backoff enabled; local simulator shows transient misses suppressed after second backoff. pushing to canaries in 10m.
sam (oncall): thanks. i'm marking paging mitigated for now. keeping thread open for post-incident writeup. quick summary for handoff: "Probe flapping after recent runtime restart; applied snooze, increased cadence/backoff, added dashboard & annotations, support tickets filed; monitoring PR and RFC to follow."
leah (sre): created monitoring PR: https://redwood.internal/mon/PR-4523 (contains alert changes and dashboard panels).
omar (eng-runtime): filed RFC: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/rfc-probe-defaults-2024
sam (oncall): handoff to next oncall in 45m — please verify snooze expiry and check Synth Stability panel 15m after canary push. :white_check_mark:
